name: Saeedeh Sadeghi
abstract_title: A Large-Scale Statistical Analysis of Temporal Patterns in Purported Past-Life Memory Cases
abstract: Background: Children who claim to remember what appears to be a past life have been studied for decades. However, only recently has systematic quantitative analysis of these cases become possible with a comprehensive database of over 2,200 cases. Among reported features, intermission time—the duration between the claimed previous person's death and the child's birth—represents an objectively measurable variable suitable for statistical analysis.
